audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart contradicted its own prose: win[0]/phases[0].side read 'Skill' while whys[0] says Aatrox wins level 1, and win[1]/phases[1].side read 'Yorick' while whys[1] and spikes[0].text both say Aatrox owns levels 1-2. win[2]/phases[2].side read 'Yorick' while whys[2] says level 3 evens out.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Aatrox, Aatrox, Skill, Skill, Skill, Yorick, Yorick — which matches every prose line in the matchup. Aatrox's Q edge out-ranges point-blank Last Rites and Deathbringer Stance heals the exchange back, so levels 1-2 are his; Mourning Mist at 3 levels it.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Aatrox / Aatrox / Skill / Skill / Skill / Yorick / Yorick across both layers, proposed as one atomic pair-matched group.

audit.why: Spike structure is right: Aatrox levels 1-2, level 6 even on both ults, Yorick favoured at first item and dominant at 2+. Only the level-6 entry lacked the real cooldown and the anti-heal lever.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text now carries World Ender's 120s rank-1 cooldown and names Grievous Wounds as what removes his extended-fight engine.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated: Dark Procession (W) is destructible terrain that blocks Umbral Dash, and dosFull[2].d under the heading 'W-cage his dashes' did not describe caging at all — it repeated a World Ender line. dontsFull[1].d under 'Trade into his Q sweetspots' likewise described a cooldown, not the Q.
audit.why: Yorick W creates terrain (blocks paths and dashes) on a 20/18/16/14/12s cooldown; Aatrox E Umbral Dash is a dash on 9/8/7/6/5s. Walling his exit is the interaction that wins the all-in. Aatrox's Q deals its heaviest damage on the outer edge, so standing inside the swing is the counterplay.
audit.corrected: dosFull[2].d and dontsFull[1].d rewritten to state the real interactions; mid/late now name Mourning Mist's 12s and Dark Procession blocking Umbral Dash.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere (sequencingCues 0).
audit.why: Aatrox's Q is 14s at rank 1 and World Ender 120s — both are long enough that 'step in after' advice is concrete.
audit.corrected: early now says step in only after the third Darkin Blade swing whiffs, with the 14s rank-1 number.

audit.whatIsWrong: Grievous Wounds was listed in itemization but never tied to the moment it matters.
audit.why: missingInteractions rule 'needs-antiheal': Aatrox sustains through Deathbringer Stance, Umbral Dash's passive heal and World Ender's healing amp — anti-heal timing decides extended trades.
audit.corrected: mid and spikes[1].text now require Grievous Wounds applied before committing into World Ender.

edits.before: Aatrox out-trades you at levels 1-2 — his Q1 sweetspot out-ranges your Last Rites and his passive heal wins the auto exchanges, so give up the early CS you can't safely grab and don't walk into his Q edge.
edits.after: Aatrox out-trades you at levels 1-2 — The Darkin Blade's outer edge out-ranges Last Rites and Deathbringer Stance heals the exchange back. His Q is 14s at rank 1: step in only after the third swing whiffs.

edits.before: From level 3 on it's a skill matchup: lead with E Mourning Mist to slow and reveal him, then Q the marked target for bonus damage while sidestepping his second and third Q casts. Respect his level-6 World Ender — only commit all-ins with Maiden summoned.
edits.after: From level 3 it's a skill matchup: lead with Mourning Mist (E, 12s) to slow and shred his armor, then Last Rites the marked target while your ghouls sprint at it. Respect World Ender at 6 — commit only with Maiden up and Grievous Wounds already on him.

edits.before: Once your first item and full Cage are online you flip ahead: W traps his dashes, Maiden shreds him in extended trades, and by 2+ items you out-split and out-1v1 him across the map.
edits.after: Once your first item and rank-5 Dark Procession (12s) land you flip ahead: the wall blocks Umbral Dash out, Maiden grinds him down, and by 2+ items you out-split and out-1v1 him across the map.

edits.before: Both ults are strong here so it stays even: your Maiden pressures but Aatrox's World Ender resets his healing and gives move speed, letting him win extended fights. Don't int a solo all-in into his ult — trade with Maiden up and mist-marked Q spacing.
edits.after: Both ults swing it, so 6 stays even: Maiden pressures, but World Ender (120s at rank 1) amplifies his healing and speed to win the long fight. Executioner's Calling cuts that engine — with Grievous Wounds on, his ult brawl stops out-sustaining you.

edits.before: Aatrox wastes World Ender — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Dark Procession walls off Umbral Dash — cage his exit, then commit.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Its outer edge hits hardest — stand inside the swing, not on the rim.
